items.question: What yacht management services do you provide?
items.answer: We provide full 360° management: technical supervision, planned maintenance, refit management, crew recruitment and payroll, insurance and class compliance, operational planning, and transparent financial reporting.

items.question: Do you manage international yachts?
items.answer: Yes. Our visiting yacht agency supports international vessels arriving to Saudi waters with clearance, permits, berthing, provisioning, logistics and concierge services.

items.question: Do you provide crew recruitment?
items.answer: We recruit, vet and manage certified marine professionals from captains and engineers to interior and service crew, including contracts, payroll and ongoing training.

items.question: How can I request consultation?
items.answer: Send us a message through the contact form or call our operations desk. A dedicated manager will respond within one business day to arrange a private consultation.

admin.demoHint: Demo: admin@lunayairmarina.com or editor@lunayairmarina.com — any password works.
admin.firebaseHint: Uses Firebase Auth. First login with a new email creates the Super Admin if none exist. Enable Email/Password in Firebase Console.
admin.loginFailed: Login failed. Check email, password and Firebase Auth settings.
admin.authProviderDisabled: Email/Password is disabled in Firebase. Open Console → Authentication → Sign-in method → Enable Email/Password for project lunayairmarina-2d694.
admin.authInvalidCredentials: Invalid email or password. Forgot it? From Users, click the key icon to email a reset link, or delete and recreate the user with a known password.
admin.authUserNotFound: User not found. Create it from Users, or first login bootstraps Super Admin.
admin.authEmailInUse: Email already registered. Use the correct password.
admin.authTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again later.
admin.authUnauthorizedDomain: Domain not allowed. Add it in Firebase Auth → Settings → Authorized domains.
admin.authNoProfile: Account is inactive or has no admin profile in Firestore.
admin.authLocalOnly: Signed in locally only. Enable Email/Password in Firebase for cloud sync.
admin.authPermissionDenied: Firestore blocked the write. Publish firestore.rules from this project, then retry.
admin.authNetwork: Network issue reaching Firebase. Check your connection and retry.
